Archery features an automated target cart system that can be controlled to move forward/backward and stop at any position, allowing archers to shoot at their preferred distance. When the target is full of arrows, simply press the advance button on the LCD control panel to bring the cart forward for arrow retrieval - all without disrupting neighboring lanes. Equipped with an image capture system, the target transmits real-time scoring data via cable to the LCD display, providing clear visual feedback of shot accuracy in a convenient and safe manner.



>> Features of Movable Archery Range:


  • Automated Target Cart System: Easily control target position with forward, backward, and stop functions.

  • Distance Customization: Archers can choose their ideal shooting range for personalized practice.

  • One-Touch Arrow Retrieval: Move the target forward effortlessly via LCD panel without entering the range.

  • Real-Time Image Capture: Camera system captures shots and transmits visual scoring data.

  • LCD Display Feedback: Provides instant, clear accuracy metrics and shot grouping visuals.

  • Quiet Operation: Low-noise motor ensures smooth target movement without distracting others.

  • Safety-First Design: Automated functions reduce the need for manual intervention on the range.



>> Advantages and Applications for the Movable Archery Range:


Efficiency in Training: Rapid target adjustment and feedback loop improve practice sessions.


Enhanced Safety: Minimizes human movement within the shooting area for safer training environments.


Ideal for All Skill Levels: Suitable for beginners to professionals seeking accurate feedback and customization.

Data-Driven Coaching: Coaches can analyze precise shot data to tailor training programs.


Multipurpose Venues: Perfect for archery clubs, schools, indoor training centers, sports complexes, and military practice ranges.


Non-Disruptive Use: Allows simultaneous training in multi-lane setups without interference.



>> Product Number: LJST016


  • Floor area: 10m*1.02m*3m

  • Number of people: 1 person

  • Participation time: 3-15 minutes

  • Power: 100w



>> FAQs for Movable Archery Range:


Q1: Can the shooting distance be adjusted automatically?

A1: Yes, the motorized cart allows you to move the target to your preferred distance using the LCD control panel.


Q2: How do I retrieve the arrows safely?

A2: Press the "advance" button on the panel to bring the target forward—no need to enter the lane manually.


Q3: Is real-time scoring available?

A3: Yes, the built-in image capture system sends live scoring data to the LCD display for immediate review.


Q4: Is the system noisy during operation?

A4: No, the system operates quietly to ensure a calm, focused practice environment.


Q5: Can this be used outdoors?

A5: While primarily designed for indoor or covered environments, it can be adapted for outdoor use with proper weatherproofing.
